opus.problem: Saying the crowds shouted 'this' to the Son of David nearly quotes the famous phrase 'Hosanna to the Son of David.' It gives the word away on its own, so it is not medium hard.
Quoting 'in the highest' completes the well-known phrase 'Hosanna in the highest.' This single clue gives the word away, so it is not medium hard.

The verse never contains the word, and the clue does not point to it. It describes the leaders' question and Jesus' reply about praise from infants, so 'praise' fits as well as Hosanna. Read alone, the clue does not lead to this word.
